response.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS per_day_rental_price, (AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration)) / (SELECT AVG(rating_daily_price) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS rating_daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating) AS rating_prices) AS relative_to_mean_rating_daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating;
